_about: Example content for data/mars/learning/ngss_map.json (ARCHITECTURE.md 8.6). Goal ID + band -> NGSS codes. Owners: Lead Instructional Designer and SME. Source: LEARNING.md 6.1, from docs/science/ngss-verification.md (SME, 2026-11-26). Codes checked via state mirrors and search copies; a word-for-word check on nextgenscience.org is still outstanding. C1/C2 split confirmed by the SME in round 2 (docs/science/round2-review.md 3.4), with HS C2 changed to HS-ETS1-2 and HS-ETS1-4. Round 2: each goal also carries tier (LEARNING.md §1, decided option T-C), scope (always 'player': goal pages fill only from the player's own events, LEARNING.md 3.0), and record_title_key (language-file key of the Keeper's Record page title, for goals.csv). Round 3: all codes checked word for word on nextgenscience.org by the SME (docs/science/ngss-verification.md, Round 3). 'ms_related' added to every goal (same meaning as 'hs_related': a real but partial fit, shown to teachers, never counted as alignment); B5 gets MS-ESS3-3 as related.

A1.note: Assessed with data, not recall. HS: background knowledge.

A2.note: MS via DCI PS1.A (state changes with temperature or pressure). HS extends MS-PS1-4; HS-ESS2-5 only if water-regolith effects are shown.

A3.note: MS-ESS3-5 counts via the Earth debrief (period 14).

A4.note: MS: concept only. HS-PS4-4 covers EM radiation only; magnetic shielding is beyond it.

A5.note: HS-ESS2-6 needs the carbon flow view on the Monitor.

B2.note: MS-LS2-4 does not cover feedback loops.

B3.note: MS: practice only (Developing and using models). HS-ESS3-6's assessment boundary limits it to using published model results: the debrief's published Earth data carries it, not the game.

B4.note: HS-LS2-6 needs the claim-evaluation question in Keeper's Report 3 (HS).

B5.note: MS-ESS3-3 (verified round 3) is related, not aligned: it fits only with an Earth example of an intervention's side effect (e.g. CFCs, cane toads; cta.md §4).

C1.note: SME round 2: keep. HS-ETS1-1 counts only where the transfer task or a debrief pairs C1 with an Earth challenge.

C2.note: SME round 2: HS-ETS1-3 dropped (it belongs to B4/B5). HS-ETS1-4 is a moderate fit. MS-ETS1-3 fits only if failure reports let the player compare fixes; otherwise treat it as related.

D1.note: No PE; NGSS PEs don't assess values. SEP: Engaging in argument from evidence.

D2.note: Counts only with the D2 Earth content and debrief.
